new_problems: Chat read-back money format: commands' chf() writes whole francs without decimals ('Start a session on Shop (up to CHF 5)?') while design §5 rule 7 asks for two decimals and the spec's acceptance line shows '(up to CHF 5.00)'; the warning clause after it says 'CHF 4.00', so one sentence mixes both. Owner of startSentence/askFromChat is C3 (d1109-starts-engine); the design §5 example also writes 'CHF 5'.

Kept-work rule follows the brief's rule exactly (only paused/budget_exceeded runs count): a run stopped by a credential's limit (usage_limit) or by Stop now also leaves a work-in-progress commit (ADR 0112 point 1), but both the brief ('## The previous attempt') and keptWorkOf then treat the task as starting over (whole estimate). Widening needs both changed together (d1109-oversize-pause's task-context region).
oversizedPlanNote is the spec's exact sentence: 100 characters at a work budget under CHF 10.00, 101+ for larger work budgets (design §5 rule 1: consequence line <= 100).

The fake daemon's base chat read-back ('You want to start a session with a budget of CHF 4.00.') has long differed from the real one ('Start a session on X (up to CHF 5)?'); I only appended the warning to it (chat.test.tsx and e2e/chat.spec.ts assert the old text).
